title: history -J record
description: One entry of the undo journal, from `history -J`. One record per line (NDJSON); version 1 of the Dogfish record format (doc/ndjson.md). Fields may be added in later releases.

time.description: When the operation was recorded (whole seconds): RFC 3339, UTC, with nanoseconds.

time_ns.description: When the operation was recorded (whole seconds): nanoseconds since the epoch.

action.description: What was done: `rm` moved a file to the trash, or a file was moved or copied.

path_bytes.description: The bytes of `path`, base64, present only when they are not UTF-8 (`path` then holds the lossy form).

trash.description: Of trash: where the file is kept.

trash_bytes.description: The bytes of `trash`, base64, present only when they are not UTF-8 (`trash` then holds the lossy form).

source.description: Of move and copy: the source.

source_bytes.description: The bytes of `source`, base64, present only when they are not UTF-8 (`source` then holds the lossy form).

dest.description: Of move and copy: the destination.

dest_bytes.description: The bytes of `dest`, base64, present only when they are not UTF-8 (`dest` then holds the lossy form).

backup.description: What the destination held before, kept for undo.

backup_bytes.description: The bytes of `backup`, base64, present only when they are not UTF-8 (`backup` then holds the lossy form).

backup_purged.description: Present (true) when the backup was discarded to stay under the limit.

pending.description: Present (true) while the operation is running or was interrupted.

cancelled.description: Present (true) when the operation recorded nothing to undo.
